name: Terra Mystica

categories.label: Victory points on track (during play)
categories.hint: VP gained during the 6 rounds (scoring tiles, favors, towns, etc.).

categories.label: Fire cult track ranking
categories.hint: Highest 8 VP, 2nd 4, 3rd 2; ties split and round down. Must be above space 0.

categories.label: Water cult track ranking
categories.hint: Highest 8 VP, 2nd 4, 3rd 2; ties split and round down. Must be above space 0.

categories.label: Earth cult track ranking
categories.hint: Highest 8 VP, 2nd 4, 3rd 2; ties split and round down. Must be above space 0.

categories.label: Air cult track ranking
categories.hint: Highest 8 VP, 2nd 4, 3rd 2; ties split and round down. Must be above space 0.

categories.label: Largest connected area (buildings)
categories.labelVi: Khu vực liên kết lớn nhất
categories.hint: Count buildings in largest connected group. 1st 18, 2nd 12, 3rd 6; ties split.

categories.label: Coins after converting resources
categories.labelVi: Xu sau khi quy đổi tài nguyên
categories.hint: Convert workers, priests, and power to coins first; 1 VP per 3 coins.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: players tied on VP all win.

notes: Base game final scoring. Cult 8/4/2 and area18/12/6 ties pool places and floor. Alchemists score1VP per2Coins; other factions1per3. Resource input is coins after legal conversions. Largest network includes legal shipping/tunneling/carpet flight; not Witches Ride or temporary bonus-card shipping. Expansions not automated.

sources.title: Terra Mystica official English v3 rules
sources.section: p16: cult, area, resources; Alchemists exception
